content: Interra Baton is an AI/ML-powered automated media QC platform: video checks (unwanted frames, field order, dropout, ghosting, black bars, black levels), audio checks (Nielsen watermarking, loudness), AI checks (language ID, lip-sync, violence/content classification). Built-in test plans for DPP, iTunes, Netflix, CableLabs, ARD_ZDF, ingest/playout specs. This is spec-compliance QC against delivery standards, not build-to-build regression diffing.
